title: Gravitational-wave signals in the LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA catalogue, at each release
description: Bar chart. The cumulative number of candidate signals, with a probability of astrophysical origin of at least one half, in the Gravitational-Wave Transient Catalog at each release: GWTC-1 (2018, through the second observing run), 11; GWTC-3 (2021, through the third), 90; GWTC-4.0 (2025, through the first part of the fourth), 218; GWTC-5.0 (2026, through the second part of the fourth), 390. Data: the catalogues' abstracts, arXiv:1811.12907, 2111.03606, 2508.18082 and 2605.27225.
heading: SIGNALS IN THE CATALOGUE · CUMULATIVE
